title: Mobil Oil Exploration & Producing Southeast v. United States — restitution
shortTitle: Mobil Oil Exploration & Producing Southeast v. United…
summary: The book uses recovery of $156 million paid for lease rights to show restitution’s distinct perspective.
notes: The possibility that the promised venture would ultimately have been unprofitable does not make the restitution inquiry identical to expectation. The neighboring land-deposit and lottery examples ask how the transfer, later value, and contractual promise affect the selected measure.
